reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

For individuals with a diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease, mild cognitive impairment or dementia, measurement of the following biomarkers IS REIMBURSABLE:

Amyloid beta peptides (CPT Code 82233, CPT code 82234, CPT code 0358U)

The ratio (CPT code 0459U) of total tau (t-tau) (CPT code 84394) to amyloid beta 1-42 (Aβ42) (CPT code 82234)

The ratio (CPT code 0445U) of phosphorylated tau 181 (p-tau181) (CPT code 84393) to Aβ42 (CPT code 82234)

The ratio of p-tau 217 (p-tau217) (CPT code 84393, CPT code 0479U) to Aβ42 (CPT code 82234)

When not ordered in conjunction with Aβ42 (CPT code 82234), measurement of the following biomarkers IS NOT REIMBURSABLE:

t-tau (CPT code 84394)

p-tau181 (CPT code 84393)

p-tau217 (CPT code 84393, CPT code 0479U)

For individuals with a diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease, mild cognitive impairment or dementia, measurement of other biomarkers (CPT code 83520, CPT code 83884, CPT code 0547U) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

For individuals with a diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease, mild cognitive impairment or dementia, measurement of all other cerebral spinal fluid biomarkers (CPT code 0393U, CPT code 0443U, CPT code 0548U) or plasma biomarkers (CPT code 0479U, CPT code 0551U) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

The use of DISCERNTM (CPT code 0206U*, CPT code 0207U*) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

The use of other multianalyte assays (CPT code 0412U*, CPT code 0503U*, CPT code 0568U*, CPT code 0596U) for Alzheimer's disease or dementia IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Gene expression profiling to predict development of Alzheimer's disease (CPT code 0289U**) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.
